objective: Preallocate EXPLAIN predicate schema-membership sets from known schema sizes.

tasks.title: Preallocate EXPLAIN schema membership sets
tasks.result: EXPLAIN predicate schema-membership analysis now preallocates temporary column and member sets from schema shape.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
predicate_schema_members_for_explain now preallocates extracted columns from the saturating total schema width.
The schema member set now uses schemas.len() as its capacity hint.
Added direct unit coverage for local and join predicate schema membership.
